name: 星空と宇宙
css: body, html { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden !important; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
.cosmos-bg { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0e27 0%, #1a1447 50%, #2d1b69 100%); z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; }

.stars { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-image: radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px, white, transparent), radial-gradient(2px 2px at 60px 70px, white, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 50px 50px, white, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 130px 80px, white, transparent), radial-gradient(2px 2px at 90px 10px, white, transparent); background-size: 200px 200px; background-repeat: repeat; opacity: 0.8; animation: twinkle 3s infinite alternate; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes twinkle { 0% { opacity: 0.6; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }

.shooting-star { position: fixed; width: 2px; height: 2px; background: white; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border-radius: 50%; animation: shoot 4s linear infinite; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; }
.shooting-star.delay-1 { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
.shooting-star.delay-2 { animation-delay: 3s; }
@keyframes shoot { 0% { top: 10%; left: 90%; opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-45deg) translateX(0); } 100% { top: 60%; left: 30%; opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-45deg) translateX(-300px); } }
/* --- Roulette Body (Fixed Position) --- */

.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.6), 0 0 100px rgba(75, 0, 130, 0.4), inset 0 0 40px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.3); margin: 0 !important; }
/* Pointer: Fixed Top 80px */

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 20px solid transparent; border-right: 20px solid transparent; border-top: 50px solid #FFD700; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.9)); z-index: 100; pointer-events: none; }

.pointer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 30px; height: 30px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #FFF 0%, #FFD700 50%, #FFA500 100%); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 1); }

.center-planet { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 100px; height: 100px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.8), inset -10px -10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 90; pointer-events: none; }
.center-planet::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 20%; left: 25%; width: 30px; height: 25px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(8px); }

.orbit-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 520px; height: 520px; border: 2px solid rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.3); border-radius: 50%; z-index: 80; animation: rotate-ring 20s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes rotate-ring { 0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); } }

.orbit-ring::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #FFD700; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.8); }

.orbit-ring::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #87CEEB; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(135, 206, 235, 0.8); }
/* Button (Fixed Top 570px) */

#spinBtn { position: absolute; top: 570px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; padding: 15px 60px; border: 3px solid #FFD700; border-radius: 50px; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.8), 0 0 50px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-width: 200px; z-index: 100; height: 70px; }
#spinBtn:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #764ba2 0%, #667eea 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(138, 43, 226, 1), 0 0 60px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6); transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.05); }
#spinBtn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.98); }

#result { position: absolute; top: 650px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #FFD700; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.8); font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; width: 100%; text-align: center; z-index: 100; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(20, 20, 60, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #8A2BE2 !important; color: #FFF !important; }
